summary: An interim computer policy cuts the number of places to sit as well as the time each reader gets.
realLife: Greenville temporarily limited daily internet sessions and reduced the number of library computers that could go online.
inGame: needs: connected station count and session limit.

turns.pulledBy: A reader reaches the time limit with work unfinished.
turns.what: Staff explain when the reader can get another session.
turns.writesBack: The reader must plan a return visit.

turns.pulledBy: A disconnected station is restored to service.
turns.writesBack: The branch can serve someone else during the same period.
